Cast Monastery Swiftspear immediately. It costs {R} (one red mana), my Mountain provides that. Haste lets it attack this turn, and Prowess synergizes with my Monstrous Rage and burn spells for mid-combat tricks. Best turn-2 play.

Mono-red aggro must establish the clock early against control. Leaf 0 (no attack) leaves us at parity while they develop threats — bad for an aggressive deck. Leaf 1 (attack) deals 1 damage unblocked, starts our clock, and Swiftspear is safe tapped since they have no creatures yet. Racing matters more than holding back.
